ignoreValues.reason: static scan assumes a default white page background; this panel's .lgp-content sits over .lgp-tint (rgba(12,12,12,.38)) atop the dark .lgp-source (#0c0c0c) refraction clone, so #fafafa text is high-contrast in the real composited scene. Demo placeholder text only.
intentional: .lgp-panel's overflow:hidden clips the refraction/rim layers to the panel's own rounded rect, which is this primitive's job. No tooltip/menu/popover involved.

pre-existing technique carried over unchanged from the original 15s cut (text-shimmer.html recipe): #wordmark and #verify-word use a moving background-position gradient clipped to text as the single specular shimmer sweep GSAP animates across, not static decorative gradient fill.

pre-existing .label class carried over unchanged from the original 15s cut: short uppercase JetBrains Mono scene/panel labels (e.g. '02 / ARCHITECTURE'), which the tool's own guidance says wide tracking is fine for.

pre-existing .slam .w treatment carried over unchanged from the original 15s cut: GATED/SIGNED/RECORDED full-screen kinetic-slam words (caption-kinetic-slam recipe), short single words not a body-text passage.

pre-existing #grain-tex carried over unchanged from the original 15s cut (grain-overlay.html recipe): a deliberately near-invisible film-grain texture at 0.07 opacity, the documented default for this primitive.

pre-existing rgb-glitch-text technique carried over unchanged from the original 15s cut: REFUSE/FAILURE each render 3x as stacked ghost copies (red-shift, cyan-shift, solid) that GSAP offsets to produce the RGB tear, per rgb-glitch-text.html's documented three-copy structure.

root html/body/#root overflow:hidden is the composition's own frame boundary (a fixed 1920x1080 video canvas cannot let content escape its own edge, that's the render surface, not a UI viewport with popovers). The .card.glass / .arm.glass / .agent-panel.glass clips are the liquid-glass technique itself (compositions/components/liquid-glass-panel.html): each panel's overflow:hidden confines its own .glass-refract/.card-edge/.link decorative children to the panel's own rounded rect, exactly like the registered component's .lgp-panel. No tooltip/menu/popover involved anywhere in this file.
